decisions.decision: AES-256-GCM with 96-bit random nonce + AAD b"dlp:secret:<table>:<column>"
decisions.rationale: AEAD with column-bound AAD prevents ciphertext substitution across columns

decisions.decision: Wave 1 executor switched from secrecy::SecretBox<[u8;32]> to zeroize::Zeroizing<[u8;32]> for KEK storage
decisions.rationale: secrecy 0.8 SecretBox requires Box<S>: Zeroize but zeroize 1.8 only implements it for Box<[T]> slice form, not Box<[T;N]> sized-array form; Zeroizing provides equivalent on-drop zeroisation with manual Debug redaction on SecretCrypto

decisions.decision: Wave 2 47-02 kept SecretCrypto's inline SQL for secret_kek_history; repository is additive (sibling-pattern), not a replacement
decisions.rationale: Per Wave 1 executor handoff; non-breaking; future refactor can collapse duplication

decisions.decision: Wave 2 47-03 secrets_jwt upsert uses UPDATE-then-INSERT, not INSERT OR REPLACE
decisions.rationale: INSERT OR REPLACE does DELETE+INSERT internally, would clobber created_at; UPDATE-then-INSERT preserves created_at while stamping rotated_at on rotation
